codeReview.summary: Solid, well-structured implementation of the EntityList widget. The code is clean, uses theme tokens exclusively (no raw color literals), has no non-deterministic calls in render/reducer code, and covers all required behaviors (navigation, wrap-around, focus indicator, empty/loading/error states). One test bug found (TestNoWrapAround missing WithFocused(true)), but the underlying no-wrap logic is correct — it's just undertested via unit tests. All 26 EntityList tests pass under -race.

issues.description: TestNoWrapAround does not set WithFocused(true), so HandleKey returns false immediately at the early focus guard (entity_list.go:196). The test passes for the wrong reason — it's verifying that unfocused lists ignore keys, not that no-wrap-around navigation clamps at boundaries. The underlying moveDown()/moveUp() no-wrap logic (lines 230, 246) appears correct but is untested by unit tests. The no-wrap behavior does get exercised indirectly in TestSingleItemNavigation (which uses WithWrapAround(false) AND WithFocused(true)), but that test only covers the single-item edge case, not the boundary clamp case (last item → down stays, first item → up stays).

summary: EntityList widget is well-implemented with comprehensive test coverage. Implementation matches the component spec (docs/plans/tui-redesign/component-spec.md) closely: all documented props are present, keyboard behavior matches the spec table, focus indicator uses colored left border (▌) via theme.Colors.BorderFocus (not font-weight only), and empty/loading/error state overlays are integrated. 22 MockTerminal unit tests + 4 snapshot tests + 3 tuistory PNGs. All tests pass under -race. One non-blocking issue: TestNoWrapAround is missing WithFocused(true), making it a redundant unfocused-key-guard test rather than a true no-wrap-around boundary test.
